description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_SafeIframe` which implements safety checks for iframe URIs within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for preparing regex patterns and filtering URIs based on configuration and context, specifically focusing on ensuring that only safe iframes are permitted.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_SafeIframe
classes.description: A class that implements security filtering for iframe URIs to ensure they conform to safe iframe policies within the HTMLPurifier framework.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the regex pattern for safe iframe URIs based on the configuration.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Performs filtering on a given URI, considering current context and whitelist rules to determine if the iframe URI is safe.
